scripts.build: pnpm --filter @metamorph-labs/almira-sdk build && pnpm --filter @metamorph-labs/almira-cli build && pnpm --filter @metamorph-labs/almira-mcp build && pnpm --filter @metamorph-labs/almira-example-node-upload build
scripts.check: pnpm check:foundation && pnpm check:advisories && pnpm check:plugins && pnpm check:wiring && pnpm check:examples && pnpm contracts:verify && pnpm build && pnpm test:contracts && pnpm test:wiring && pnpm test:sdk && pnpm test:python && pnpm test:go && pnpm test:rust && pnpm test:jvm && pnpm test:dotnet && pnpm test:swift && pnpm test:php && pnpm test:dart && pnpm test:ruby && pnpm test:cli && pnpm test:mcp && pnpm test:examples
scripts.check:advisories: cargo deny --manifest-path sdks/rust/Cargo.toml check advisories && pnpm audit --audit-level low
scripts.test:rust: cd sdks/rust && cargo test --locked --all-targets && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test:dart: cd sdks/dart && dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test && dart analyze && dart test
scripts.test:ruby: ruby -c sdks/ruby/lib/almira.rb && gem build sdks/ruby/almira.gemspec --output /tmp/metamorph-almira.gem && ruby sdks/ruby/test/client_test.rb
